t_advice_summary_textbox.text: You will see patterns in the rewards based on your choices however this can change after time.

vb_textbox.text: When you first begin a round just select a random colour and go from there and see which ones give you the higher reward. After a couple of goes of that you should note in your mind that 'X' colour is better over 'Z' colour. It can change as the experiment goes on and if you notice this then change your option and go for the other colour.
